summary: PSEG completed a public offering of $500M aggregate principal amount of 4.800% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes were sold via underwriting agreement with Barclays, Citigroup, and Goldman Sachs as representatives. Issued under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3), the notes are governed by an indenture dated 1998 with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. No special-situation event; this is a routine debt issuance under an effective shelf, not a tender offer, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action.
